export function createRegistry(){const slots=new Map<string,Lease>();let serial=0;return {claim(key:string,now:number,ttl:number){const prior=slots.get(key);if(prior&&prior.expiresAt>now)return null;const lease={token:++serial,expiresAt:now+ttl};slots.set(key,lease);return lease;},release(key:string){return slots.delete(key);},current(key:string){return slots.get(key)??null;}};}
